business.what_it_does: Hospital operator that is adding about 1,500 beds: Pune opened with 75 beds in Q3 FY26, and Hyderabad, Kolkata, Bangalore and Gurgaon are due in FY27. It also runs pharmacy stores (~600 openings a year) and a digital/online pharmacy business tracked on GMV.

segments.name: Hospitals
segments.comment: Revenue share not stated. About 1,500 beds being added, roughly half in FY27 and the rest early FY28 (C4, C5). Ramp-up losses guided at ~INR150 crore (G4).

segments.name: Pharmacy stores
segments.comment: Revenue share not stated. Guided at ~18% same-store growth and ~600 store additions a year (G10, G11).

segments.name: Digital / online pharmacy
segments.comment: Revenue share not stated. At Q3 FY26, online-pharmacy GMV grew 32% but overall GMV was roughly flat, after adjusting for a GST cut and the Amazon channel exit (~INR75 crore in Q3). Positive at CM1 level (C2, C3).

credibility.label: medium
credibility.summary: Both checkable growth targets fall well short on reported consolidated numbers (FY26 15.2% vs ~28%; H1 FY27 20.9% vs ~30%), though they were set on an adjusted basis the inputs don't show. Every hospital-opening milestone due by Q2 FY27 is untestable because no call after Q3 FY26 is in the inputs, while reported margins and cash flow keep improving.

promises.evidence: Check: FY26 revenue grew 15.2% against ~28% guided. The basis looks mismatched: the quote targets growth 'adjusted' for the GST cut and Amazon exit (C2) and excluding IP/OP, apparently for one sub-business, while the check uses reported consolidated growth. The adjusted figure is not in the inputs, so the miss is established on reported numbers only.

Check: 20.9% YoY for the first two quarters of FY27 against ~30%; Q2 FY27 alone was 23.0% (F:rev_yoy_last_q_pct). The same caveat as G12 applies: the check measures consolidated reported growth against an adjusted, narrower target.

No ramp-up loss figure is given after Q3 FY26, when Pune and Athena carried ~INR15 crore of losses (C1). The operating margin rose to 15.6% in Q2 FY27 from 14.9% a year earlier (F:margin_last_q_pct, F:margin_same_q_last_year_pct), so there is no visible dilution, but the inputs don't confirm which hospitals have opened.
FY26 GMV is not in the inputs. At Q3 FY26, online-pharmacy GMV grew 32%, but overall GMV was 'at a flatter basis' after adjustments (C3, C2).

No call after Q3 FY26 is in the inputs, so the number of beds opened in H1 FY27 is unknown. The target is consistent with C5 (half of ~1,500 beds in FY27). Gurgaon had already slipped 2-3 months before FY27 began (C7).
FY27 runs to March 2027, and there is no status update after Q3 FY26 in the inputs. Environmental delays had already pushed Gurgaon from Q1 to Q2 FY27 (C1, C7).
Same as G14: half of ~1,500 beds in FY27 (C5), with no later update in the inputs.

The scope is not stated. If it is consolidated, TTM revenue of INR27,630 crore (F:ttm_revenue_cr) already exceeds INR25,000 crore, which suggests the target is for a narrower business whose revenue isn't in the inputs.
No same-store growth figures are in the inputs.
Due early FY28; no update in the inputs.

Q1 FY27 has ended, but no call after Q3 FY26 is in the inputs to confirm the three openings. Revenue growth accelerated to 23.0% in Q2 FY27 from 18.7% in Q1 (F:rev_yoy_last4_pct), but the inputs don't let that be attributed to new hospitals.
This date was already a 2-3 month slip from Q1, caused by environmental delays (C1, C7). Q2 FY27 has ended, and no later call confirms the opening.
No store count is in the inputs.
Two-year window from Q3 FY26, and no hospital-level profitability is in the inputs. This target uses 1,300 beds, against ~1,500 in C4.
Q4 FY26 revenue growth was 18.1% against 17.2% in Q3 FY26 (F:rev_yoy_last4_pct), a small step-up. Neither the deferred amount nor its recovery is disclosed.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Revenue growth of ~28% in FY26 and ~30% in FY27 on management's adjusted basis (G12, G13, C2).
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Reported consolidated growth was 15.2% in FY26 and 20.9% in H1 FY27, and the 3-year revenue CAGR is 14.9%. The adjusted series is never shown.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: New hospitals will bring ~INR150 crore of ramp-up losses (G4, C1).
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: The operating margin rose four quarters running (14.9%, 15.3%, 15.5%, 15.6%), and Q2 FY27 PAT grew 33.6% YoY. Either the losses are smaller than guided or the openings are later than planned; the inputs can't tell which.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Phased commissioning will 'optimize capital deployment and drive occupancy-led operating leverage' (C5).
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: 5-year CFO/PAT is 1.56 and 5-year FCF INR3,388 crore. 3-year PAT CAGR of 33.4% against revenue CAGR of 14.9%, with the margin up 260bps, shows operating leverage so far. Working capital has loosened, with CCC moving from -16 to 3 days.

bull.point: Operating leverage is visible: the margin rose four straight quarters to 15.6% (+70bps YoY), and Q2 FY27 PAT grew 33.6% on revenue growth of 23.0%.
Cash backs the profits: 5-year CFO/PAT is 1.56, 5-year FCF INR3,388 crore, and D/E 0.77.

Capacity runway: about 1,500 beds across Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Bangalore and Gurgaon, ~750 of them in FY27, with breakeven targeted within two years. Revenue growth accelerated from 17.2% to 23.0% over four quarters.

bear.point: Growth guidance misses on reported numbers: ~28% was guided for FY26 against 15.2% delivered, and ~30% for FY27 against 20.9% in H1. The guide rests on adjustments (GST cut, Amazon exit) that management chooses.
Execution slipped before FY27 started: environmental delays pushed Gurgaon 2-3 months to Q2 FY27, and the new beds carry ~INR150 crore of guided ramp-up losses, with breakeven two years out.

The digital business is not growing overall: GMV was roughly flat at Q3 FY26 against a ~30% FY26 GMV guide, with growth only in online pharmacy (+32%). ROCE is 17%, with INR8,149 crore of borrowings ahead of the bed build.

questions: Which of Hyderabad, Kolkata, Bangalore and Gurugram are operating today, and how many of the 750 FY27 beds are live?
What were FY26 and H1 FY27 growth on the adjusted basis behind the 28% and 30% guides, and what exactly is excluded? Please reconcile to the reported 15.2% and 20.9%.
How much of the ~INR150 crore ramp-up loss is in H1 FY27, given margins rose to 15.6%, and is the INR25,000 crore run-rate target consolidated or for one business?
